name: Austin-Bergstrom International Airport

runway.v: two runways, 18R/36L 12,250 ft x 150 ft (about 3,734 m x 46 m) and 18L/36R 9,000 ft x 150 ft

curfew.v: no curfew; the airport says federal law limits its ability to restrict when aircraft operate
curfew.quote: No. Federal law limits an airport's ability to restrict when aircraft may operate.

customs.v: CBP arrival inspections 7 days a week 08:30-14:00 and 18:30-21:00 Central time; no landing permission 14:00-18:30; ask by phone at least 24 hours ahead (no email), arrival within +/-30 minutes; aircraft park at the FBO ramp and everyone is processed there
customs.quote: available seven days per week, from 0830-1400 and 1830-2100

permits.v: landing rights must be requested from CBP at least 24 hours before arrival, by phone only
permits.quote: at least 24 hours in advance of the anticipated arrival time at KAUS

notes: Runway from the FAA airport diagram AL-556 (chart January 2025, d-TPP cycle 19 Mar-16 Apr 2026; the newest cycle did not surface in search; the runways were renamed 18/36 from 17/35 and the airport's 2019 master plan data sheet still shows 17R/35L 12,250 ft and 17L/35R 9,000 ft). Customs from the CBP KAUS GA Airport Fact Sheet of 17 Jul 2024 (KAUS-0724); a newer sheet may exist. Curfew answer from the airport's Noise Program page (flyaustin.com, FAA outreach 2026). Hours from the City of Austin airport fact sheet (Spanish edition, undated).
